description: gr-leo is provided by Libre Space Foundation. gr-leo is a GNU Radio out-of-tree module modelling the channel between orbiting satellites and ground stations. Its C++ blocks represent Doppler shift, trajectory-dependent path loss and atmospheric effects. Geographic context: global. Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here. Source code and documentation are linked through the public repository; no software was installed or executed. The cited material was readable without payment. Reuse licence: GPL-3.0.  Users combine the blocks with GNU Radio components. Scenario validity depends on the chosen orbital and propagation assumptions; no execution was performed. Potential simulation use: Model changing satellite-ground radio-channel conditions. For catalogue navigation, platform-gnss-sdr offers related simulation context; this comparison does not assert an implemented connection.
